changes.text: option under Settings → Access → Sign-in to make single sign-on the only way admins and members sign in
Jellyfin plays the server sends unchanged show as Direct Play, even when the client reports Direct Stream

duplicate titles merged in a library sync keep the copy Tracearr added first, so a library always merges the same way
episodes whose TVDB ids differ are no longer merged into one, even with the same IMDb id; earlier merges stay merged
